description: Java class implementing a TransactionFactory that retrieves JNDI-based TransactionManager and UserTransaction objects, manages DataSource connections via JNDI lookups, and caches DataSources for reuse.

classes.name: JNDITransactionFactory
classes.description: Implements TransactionFactory to provide JNDI-based transaction management and DataSource connection handling.

methods.name: getTransactionManager
methods.description: Retrieves the TransactionManager from JNDI, caching the result.

methods.name: getUserTransaction
methods.description: Retrieves the UserTransaction from JNDI, caching the result.

methods.name: getTxMgrName
methods.description: Returns the name identifier for this transaction manager, 'jndi'.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Obtains a database connection based on helper info, either via JNDI or inline JDBC.

methods.name: getJndiConnection
methods.description: Performs JNDI lookup for DataSource, manages XADataSource connections, and caches DataSources.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: No operation; method for shutdown procedures.
